Load packages.
```{r load packages, echo = FALSE}

library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(RCurl)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(colorspace)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(presto)
library(ggrepel)
library(simspec)
library(ggrepel)
library(uwot)


source("/home/marinani/Scripts/Data_analysis/feature_plots.r")
source("/home/marinani/Scripts/Data_analysis/r_util.r")
source("/home/marinani/Scripts/Data_analysis/differential_expression.r")


# reorder the samples in the metadata to appear in the order desired by us
mg_cocult_levels <- factor(c("MG-d3-ctrl","MG-d15-ctrl","MG-d30-ctrl","MG-d58-ctrl", "MG-d3-cocul","MG-d15-cocul", "MG-d30-cocul","MG-d58-cocul"))
# generate color palette based on vintage_cols palette
col_sample <-setNames(c(c("#94D2BD","#58B6AC", "#026D7D", "#002C3D", "#D9BE6D", "#E69000", "#C73E04", "#861D21")), mg_cocult_levels)

# reorder the samples in the metadata to appear in the order desired by us
my_levels <- factor(c("remodelling microglia", "inflammatory microglia", "resting microglia", "lipid associated microglia", "proliferating microglia", "smooth muscle cell","neuron"))
# generate color palette based on vintage_cols palette
col_ct <-setNames(c(rev(pastel_contrast_cols(7))), my_levels)

# reorder the samples in the metadata to appear in the order desired by us
mg_primary_ct_levels <- factor(c("Homeostatic microglia (early)", "Homeostatic microglia (late)", "Activated microglia", "Proliferating microglia", "SOX-medium microglia", "SOX-hi microglia", "Monocyte", "Perivascular macrophage", "Erythrocyte"))
# generate color palette based on vintage_cols palette
col_primary_ct <-setNames(c(rev(rainbow_pastel_cols(9))), mg_primary_ct_levels)

```

```{r load and prepare primary microglia Kracht}

# logCP10k-primary vs. logUMInorm-organoid
load("/links/groups/treutlein/USERS/zhisong_he/Work/public_datasets/Kracht_Science_2020_human_fetal_microglia_scRNAseq_ATACseq/niches_avgExpr_meta.RData")

# Load primary fetal microglia
seurat_MG <- readRDS("/links/groups/treutlein/USERS/zhisong_he/Work/public_datasets/Kracht_Science_2020_human_fetal_microglia_scRNAseq_ATACseq/seurat.rds")

# Generate uwot model
umap_model <- uwot::umap(Embeddings(seurat_MG,"pca")[,1:20], metric="cosine", ret_model=T, n_neighbors=30L, n_components=2L, n_epochs=NULL, learning_rate=1.0, min_dist=0.3, spread=1.0, set_op_mix_ratio=1.0, local_connectivity=1L, repulsion_strength=1, negative_sample_rate=5, a=NULL, b=NULL, fast_sgd=F)
umap_model$embedding <- Embeddings(seurat_MG,"umap")
save_uwot(umap_model, file="/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/Kracht_primary_microglia/kracht_uwot_model_pca.uwot")

# high-res clusters for projection
avg_pca_niches <- t(sapply(levels(seurat_MG$RNA_snn_res.10), function(cl) colMeans(Embeddings(seurat_MG,"pca")[which(seurat_MG$RNA_snn_res.10==cl),1:20])))
avg_expr_niches <- sapply(levels(seurat_MG$RNA_snn_res.10), function(cl) rowMeans(seurat_MG@assays$RNA@data[,which(seurat_MG$RNA_snn_res.10==cl),]))
umap_niche_projected <- umap_transform(X=avg_pca_niches, model=umap_model)
meta_niches <- setNames(data.frame(sapply(c("source","timepoint_days","timepoint_wks","celltype"), function(col) sapply(levels(seurat_MG$RNA_snn_res.10), function(cl) names(which.max(table(seurat_MG@meta.data[which(seurat_MG$RNA_snn_res.10 == cl),col])))))), c("source","timepoint_days","timepoint_wks","celltype"))
meta_niches$timepoint_days <- as.numeric(meta_niches$timepoint_days)
meta_niches$timepoint_wks <- as.numeric(meta_niches$timepoint_wks)

vargenes_niches <- VariableFeatures(seurat_MG)

## binarized normalized data
bin_counts <- seurat_MG@assays$RNA@counts > 0
bin_counts <- t(rowNorm(t(bin_counts)))
avg_binexpr_niches <- sapply(levels(seurat_MG$RNA_snn_res.10), function(cl) rowMeans(bin_counts[,which(seurat_MG$RNA_snn_res.10==cl),]))

pdf("Plots/Kracht_primary_microglia/kracht_meta_nichess.pdf", width = 7, height = 5.5)
par(mar=c(1,1,1,1)); plotFeature(Embeddings(seurat_MG, "umap"), seurat_MG$celltype, colorPal=col_primary_ct, cex=0.5, pt_border=F, lwd_border=0.3, do_legend = T, legend_pos = "bottomright", legend_cex = 0.7)
points(umap_niche_projected, pch=21, col="#303030", lwd=1.5, bg=col_primary_ct[meta_niches$celltype], cex = 2.5)
dev.off()

# save 
save(avg_expr_niches, avg_binexpr_niches, vargenes_niches, umap_niche_projected, meta_niches, file="/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/Kracht_primary_microglia/niches_avgExpr_meta.RData")

```

```{r add sex to metadata}

# Based on the supplementary table 1 with the paper, we can add the sex of the fetus: M = male, F = female
library(stringi)
sex <- seurat_MG$fetus

sex <- stri_replace_all_regex(sex,
                                  pattern=c("donor/fetus: 2018-05", "donor/fetus: 2018-09", "donor/fetus: 2018-18", "donor/fetus: 2018-19", "donor/fetus: 2018-20", "donor/fetus: 2018-22", "donor/fetus: 2018-23", "donor/fetus: 2018-25", "donor/fetus: 2018-26", "donor/fetus: 2018-28", "donor/fetus: 2018-29", "donor/fetus: 2018-30", "donor/fetus: 2018-31", "donor/fetus: 2018-32", "donor/fetus: 2018-34", "donor/fetus: 2018-36", "donor/fetus: 2018-37", "donor/fetus: 2018-41", "donor/fetus: 2018-42", "donor/fetus: 2018-44"),
                                  replacement=c("F", "M", "F","M", "F", "M", "M", "F", "M", "F", "F", "M", "M","F", "F", "M","F", "F", "F", "M"),
                                  vectorize=FALSE)
seurat_MG[["sex"]] <- sex

```

```{r celltypes in kracht microglia}

# Find cell type markers in order to decide whether some of them need to be renamed
Idents(seurat_MG) <- "celltype"
table(seurat_MG$timepoint_wks, seurat_MG$celltype)
ct_markers_kracht <- FindAllMarkers(seurat_MG, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = log(1.2))
  
top2_ct_markers_kracht <- ct_markers_kracht %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(n = 2, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top5_ct_markers_kracht <- ct_markers_kracht %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 5, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top10_ct_markers_kracht <- ct_markers_kracht %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 10, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top50_ct_markers_kracht <- ct_markers_kracht %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 50, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top_ct_markers_kracht <- ct_markers_kracht %>% group_by(cluster) %>% arrange(desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group = TRUE)

write.csv(top_ct_markers_kracht, "Plots/Kracht_primary_microglia/top_ct_markers_kracht.csv")
write.csv(top50_ct_markers_kracht, "Plots/Kracht_primary_microglia/top50_ct_markers_kracht.csv")

```


#### Extract clearly microglia only 
```{r}

seurat_MG_only <- subset(seurat_MG, subset = celltype %in% c("Homeostatic microglia (early)", "Homeostatic microglia (late)", "Activated microglia", "Proliferating microglia", "SOX-medium microglia")) %>% 
        NormalizeData() %>%
        FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000)
seurat_MG_only <- ScaleData(seurat_MG_only, features = rownames(seurat_MG_only)) 
seurat_MG_only <- FindNeighbors(seurat_MG_only, dims = 1:20) %>%
        FindClusters(resolution = 0.3) %>%
        FindClusters(resolution = 0.5) %>%
        FindClusters(resolution = 1) %>%
        FindClusters(resolution = 10)
seurat_MG_only <- RunPCA(seurat_MG_only, npcs = 50, verbose=F) %>%
        RunUMAP(dims = 1:20)
set.seed(42)

saveRDS(seurat_MG_only, "Objects/Kracht_primary_microglia/seurat_microglia_only.rds")

```

Generate high-resolution clusters with microglia only
```{r}

# umap model
umap_model <- uwot::umap(Embeddings(seurat_MG_only,"pca")[,1:20], metric="cosine", ret_model=T, n_neighbors=30L, n_components=2L, n_epochs=NULL, learning_rate=1.0, min_dist=0.3, spread=1.0, set_op_mix_ratio=1.0, local_connectivity=1L, repulsion_strength=1, negative_sample_rate=5, a=NULL, b=NULL, fast_sgd=F)
umap_model$embedding <- Embeddings(seurat_MG_only,"umap")
save_uwot(umap_model, "/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/Kracht_primary_microglia/uwot_model_microglia_only_pca.uwot")

seurat_MG_only$timepoint_wks <- round(seurat_MG_only$timepoint_days/7)
seurat_MG_only$sample_group <- paste0(seurat_MG_only$timepoint_wks, "_", seurat_MG_only$source)

# high-res clusters for projection
avg_pca_niches <- t(sapply(levels(seurat_MG_only$RNA_snn_res.10), function(cl) colMeans(Embeddings(seurat_MG_only,"pca")[which(seurat_MG_only$RNA_snn_res.10==cl),1:20])))
avg_expr_niches <- sapply(levels(seurat_MG_only$RNA_snn_res.10), function(cl) rowMeans(seurat_MG_only@assays$RNA@data[,which(seurat_MG_only$RNA_snn_res.10==cl),]))
umap_niche_projected <- umap_transform(X=avg_pca_niches, model=umap_model)
meta_niches <- setNames(data.frame(sapply(c("source","timepoint_days","timepoint_wks","celltype"), function(col) sapply(levels(seurat_MG_only$RNA_snn_res.10), function(cl) names(which.max(table(seurat_MG_only@meta.data[which(seurat_MG_only$RNA_snn_res.10 == cl),col])))))), c("source","timepoint_days","timepoint_wks","celltype"))
meta_niches$timepoint_days <- as.numeric(meta_niches$timepoint_days)
meta_niches$timepoint_wks <- as.numeric(meta_niches$timepoint_days)
meta_niches$celltype <- factor(meta_niches$celltype, levels=mg_primary_ct_levels)
vargenes_niches <- VariableFeatures(seurat_MG_only)

## binarized normalized data
bin_counts <- seurat_MG_only@assays$RNA@counts > 0
bin_counts <- t(rowNorm(t(bin_counts)))
avg_binexpr_niches <- sapply(levels(seurat_MG_only$RNA_snn_res.10), function(cl) rowMeans(bin_counts[,which(seurat_MG_only$RNA_snn_res.10==cl),]))

save(avg_expr_niches, avg_binexpr_niches, vargenes_niches, umap_niche_projected, meta_niches, file="Objects/Kracht_primary_microglia/niches_microglia_only_avgExpr_meta.RData")
par(mar=c(1,1,1,1)); plotFeature(Embeddings(seurat_MG_only, "umap"), seurat_MG_only$celltype, colorPal=col_primary_ct, cex=0.5, pt_border=F, lwd_border=0.3, do_legend = T, legend_pos = "bottomright", legend_cex = 0.7)
points(umap_niche_projected, pch=21, col="#303030", lwd=1.5, bg=col_primary_ct[meta_niches$celltype], cex = 2.5)

# check relationship between detection rates and gene lengths
detection_rate <- rowMeans(seurat_MG_only@assays$RNA@data > 0)

gene_symbols <- read.table("/links/groups/treutlein/USERS/zhisong_he/Work/databases/Ensembl/v96/human_gencode30/human_ens_symbol_type.txt", sep="\t", header=T)
rownames(gene_symbols) <- gene_symbols[,1]
gene_len <- read.table("/links/groups/treutlein/USERS/zhisong_he/Work/databases/Ensembl/v96/human_gencode30/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.96.chr.struc")
gene_len <- setNames(gene_len[,4], gene_len[,1])
names(gene_len) <- make.unique(gene_symbols[names(gene_len),2])
gene_len <- gene_len[rownames(seurat_MG_only)]

layout(matrix(1:2,nrow=1)); par(mar=c(5,5,1,1))
boxplot(tapply(detection_rate, ceiling(rank(gene_len)/nrow(seurat_MG_only)*10), list), outline=F, ylab = "Detection rate", xlab="Gene length ranks", cex.lab=1.3)
smoothScatter(log10(gene_len), log10(detection_rate), ylab = "Log10(Detection rate)", xlab="Log10(Gene length)", cex.lab=1.3)
cor(detection_rate, gene_len, use="complete.obs", method="spearman")
cor(detection_rate[gene_len>1000], gene_len[gene_len>1000], use="complete.obs", method="spearman")
cor(log(detection_rate), log(gene_len), use="complete.obs", method="pearson")

```
